newsitem.title: CANADA: Bombardier wins C$112 mln plane order.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier wins C$112 mln plane order.

text.p: Bombardier Inc said on Tuesday that its regional aircraft division won a firm order from Tyrolean Airways for four de Havilland Dash 8 Series 400 aircraft and options for an additional four.
The montreal-based transportation conglomerate said the sale of the four aircraft is worth about US$83 million (C$112 million).
Deliveries will take place in the fourth quarter of 1999, the first and third quarters of the year 2000 and the first quarter of 2001, Bombardier said.
The Tyrolean Airways transaction increases to 15 the number of Dash 8 Series 400 aircraft on firm order.

"We are very pleased that Tyrolean, a long-term user of de Havilland products, has chosen the 72-passenger Dash 8 Series 400 for its fleet," said John Howarth, vice president, international sales, for Bombardier Regional Aircraft.
